gen-mystery-quest-gf-heebo: Nostalgic and bookish, Mystery Quest keeps its curves open and its ascenders compact. Heebo's curves stop short of closing, which lets the storybook heading hand off to a sans text band that feels current and straightforward.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-hind-guntur: Hind Guntur is a sans cut like a steel cable outline, with wide gaps where curves meet stems. Mystery Quest supplies the bookish flair, and that uniform line anchors it.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-hind-siliguri: Nostalgic and bookish, Mystery Quest supplies the personality up top. Hind Siliguri does the opposite job, holding a constant stroke weight in a flat gray hum that keeps text approachable.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-huninn: Mystery Quest wears its bookish, nostalgic side in open-jawed curves and compact ascenders, while Huninn keeps strokes that never swell or thin. Storybook charm sits beside a modern, steady sans-serif.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-karla: Mystery Quest brings bookish, nostalgic character with compact ascenders and open jaws. Karla does the other job, with a gaping c opening and a stocky middle band that feel modern and approachable.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-khula: Khula keeps its curves open around a deep, squat brush-pen belly, which gives the sans text a modern footing. And Mystery Quest above it adds the bookish, nostalgic touch, open-jawed and compact.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-kufam: Neon-sign wire meets a nostalgic, bookish flourish. Kufam pours generously open curves into one tube-like track, while Mystery Quest adds compact ascenders and open jaws overhead.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-lexend: Outsized lowercase, open jaws on every curve: that is Lexend, with a stroke that holds its thickness around bends. And Mystery Quest echoes those open jaws in a bookish, nostalgic voice with compact ascenders.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-martel-sans: Open jaws on every curved stroke give Mystery Quest its bookish, nostalgic look. Martel Sans opens every curve generously and sits along a lifted line, so running text would read steadily and without friction.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-matangi: Open jaws on every curve give Mystery Quest a bookish, nostalgic voice. Matangi presses twine-like strokes into a hefty lowercase with open rounds, a modern footing beneath that storybook flourish.
